subject.title: [Feature]: GitHub Copilot provider cannot reach GitHub Enterprise data-residency (*.ghe.com) tenants

question: Should the bundled github-copilot provider accept allowlisted GHE.com tenant routing, including COPILOT_GITHUB_DOMAIN/config domain selection and domain-scoped token-cache semantics?
rationale: This is narrower than a new provider because OpenClaw already bundles github-copilot, but it changes credential routing, token destinations, provider setup UX, and public configuration behavior.

options.title: Accept bounded provider routing
options.body: Review and harden the linked PR as the supported path for github-copilot to handle github.com and single-label *.ghe.com tenant hosts.

options.title: Move GHE routing to plugin scope
options.body: Reject bundled-provider tenant routing and require a separate plugin or ClawHub package for enterprise-specific behavior.

options.title: Require a generic host API first
options.body: Pause the linked PR until maintainers define a reusable provider-auth tenant-host contract instead of provider-specific domain selection.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded provider routing
recommendation.body: Review and harden the linked PR as the supported path for github-copilot to handle github.com and single-label *.ghe.com tenant hosts.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-main history signal on the inspected provider/auth files and recent provider localization work.
